SparkR / SPARKR-168
bug fix in Kmeans.R
Issue Type: Bug
Assignee: Unassigned
Created: 08/Jan/15 11:00 PM
Environment:

ubuntu 12.04, R 3.1.1, Hadoop 2.4.1, Spark 1.1.0
Priority: Major
Reporter: Yangxiaoqiang

In kmeans.R,
1. Line 9, in function parsevectors(), list(matrix(as.numeric(unlist(lines)), ncol = length(lines[[1]]))) should better be list(matrix(as.numeric(unlist(lines)), ncol = length(lines[[1]]), byrow = TRUE)).
2. Line 41, takeSample() doesn't work as expected, it returns the entire matrix rather than K random rows. A simple solution would be take the first K rows of the matrix by adding kPoints <- kPoints[1:K,] next to it.
3. Line 56, in reduceByKey(), t(colSums(rbind(p1, p2))) could be replaced by rbind(p1, p2) .
4. Line 64, in collect(), point.sum <- tup[[2]][, -1] should be point.sum <- colSums(tup[[2]][, -1]).

Thank you for your wonderful work of SparkR, looking forward to more convenient and stable release.
